units.statement: The source of exosomes determines their intrinsic targeting properties and immunogenicity, with tumor-cell-derived exosomes possessing inherent homing potential and immune-cell-derived exosomes capable of modulating antitumor immunity, while natural exosomes are easily cleared by the mononuclear phagocyte system resulting in minimal tumor accumulation.
source_quotes: 185 However, tumor- derived natural exosomes may lead to immune cell suppression and the escapes of immune surveillance, which extremely constrain the clinical application of natural exosomes.

Immunotherapy Engineered exosomes derived from immune cells and tumor cells, serving as immune mediators, have attracted increasing attention owing to the inherent characteristic of exosomes (Table 2).

The combination of radiotherapy and engineered exosomes with inherent surface proteins and synthetic targeting molecules, such as brain-tumor-targeting cyclic RGDyK peptide, 124 not only alleviates radio-resistance and subsequently reboot immune response, but also increases the accumulation of drug- loaded exosomes in tumor sites.

Tumor- derived exosomes after proper modification, serving as antitumor vaccine, not only inherit molecules and tumor antigens, but also lead to more powerful antitumor immune activity and lower protumorigenic effects.

units.statement: Immunoaffinity capture with submicron magnetic particles (magneto-immunocapture, yielding 10â15 times more exosomes than ultracentrifugation) and microfluidic-based isolation techniques that integrate multiple preprocessing and analytical methods in a single device achieve higher exosome recovery, purity, throughput, and sensitivity suitable for limited clinical samples, outperforming conventional methods such as ultracentrifugation, size-based filtration, size-exclusion chromatography, and polymer precipitation.
source_quotes: Conventional isolation methods of exosomes include ultracentrifugation, size-based filtration, size-exclusion chromatography, and polymer precipitation.

The microfluidic-based isolation techniques integrate multiple pre-processing steps and methodologies in a single device, which are capable of recovering, analyzing, and quantifying exosomes within limited clinical samples, in a high-throughput manner with elevated sensitivity and multiplexing capabilities.

units.statement: PEGylation and CD47 overexpression on exosome surfaces reduce recognition and internalization by the mononuclear phagocyte system, thereby avoiding clearance and significantly increasing circulation time in vivo for improved tumor delivery.
source_quotes: PEG reduces the recognition and internalization by MPS and therefore avoids being cleaned, significantly increasing the circulation time of engineered exosomes in vivo.

CD47, a widely expressed integrin-associated transmem- brane protein that functions in part to protect cells from phagocytosis, 57,58 is the ligand for signal regulatory protein alpha (SIRPÎ±, also known as CD172a), and CD47âSIRPÎ± binding initiates the âdonâteatmeâ signal, inhibiting phagocytosis. 59 Exosomes could be functionalized in order to improve retention time in blood with CD47 overexpression. 60â62 Once engineered exosomes arrive in tumor sites, CD47 immune checkpoint blockade endows CRC with the macrophages-mediated phagocytosis by blocking CD47 signal. 25,63,64 In brief, specific antibodies are the main immunological modified strategies for engineered exosomes, which endow natural exosomes with more targeting ability (Fig. 3b).

Engineering exosomes from macrophage with incorporated aminoethylanisamide-polyethylene glycol (AA-PEG) and PTX had pronounced anticancer impact on a mouse model of pulmonary metastases. 111 PEG reduces the recognition and internalization by MPS and therefore avoids being cleaned, significantly increasing the circulation time of engineered exosomes in vivo. 112 Collectively, chemotherapeutic drug-loaded exosomes could elicit more powerful antitumor activity with less systemic toxicity than that chemotherapy alone.

Therefore, a combinatorial treatment platform was presented, which inte- grated CD47-overexpressed exosomes and ICG to resolve the above problem and consequently enhance the efficacy of ICG- mediated PTT. 67,152 Additionally, another drug delivery system was designed based on exosomes-camouflaged porous silicon nano- particles, to co-load ICG and DOX.

units.statement: Biological modification using targeting peptides (e.g., c(RGDyK), tLyp-1) and aptamers (e.g., AS1411) is the most widely used strategy for exosome membrane modification and endows natural exosomes with spatial tumor-targeting properties, improving specific accumulation and barrier penetration.
source_quotes: Biological modification Biological modification is the most widely used strategy for membrane modification, including targeted peptide and biomi- metic exosome modification (Table 1).

For instance, cyclo(Arg-Gly- Asp-D-Tyr-Lys) peptide (c(RGDyK)) is one of the cyclic RGD peptide (cRGD), which endows natural exosomes with a pronounced targeting ability for tumor and exerts high affinity with Î±vÎ²â integrin receptors overexpressing on the surface of tumor vascular endothelial cells or tumor cells in osteosarcoma (OS). 36â38 Similarly, exosomes were functionalized by cyclic RGD peptide and consequently improved the specific accumulation of che- motherapeutic drugs, DOX-loaded into exosomes within tumor extracellular milieu.
In brief, specific targeting peptides and aptamers are the main biological modified strategies for engineered exosomes, which endow natural exosomes with spatially targeting property (Fig. 3b).

Aptamers are short single-stranded oligonucleotides or pep- tides with specific three-dimensional structures, targeting cancer cells with high affinity and specificity. 46,47 E3-aptamer-modified exosomes, carrying SIRT6 siRNA, exhibited remarkably antitumor effects on prostate cancer in vitro and in vivo. 48 Besides, extracellular vesicles coated with RNA aptamers are capable of binding to epithelial cell adhesion molecule (EpCAM) in HCC. 49 Similarly, AS1411 aptamer-modified macrophage exosomes pre- sent efficient blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration and precise cancer cell-targeting capability in glioblastoma (GBM). 50 Therefore, in addition to targeting peptide and antibody, aptamer is another direction of exosome engineering.

units.statement: Lipophilic dyes (PKH67, DiR/DiD, MemGlow) have been used to label engineered exosomes, but their half-lives greatly exceed those of engineered exosomes, causing recycling and redistribution of fluorescent dye that masks exosome degradation after cellular uptake; bioluminescence-based reporters (gLuc-lactadherin, GlucB) offer higher signal-to-noise and are recommended for whole-animal imaging, while SIM, CLSM, STORM, and MRI detect sub-200-nm exosomes in vivo.
source_quotes: However, as the half-life of lipid dyes greatly exceeds that of engineered exosomes, exosomes degradation after cellular uptake is masked by recycling and redistribution of fluorescent dye.
Therefore, lipophilic dye labeling may not be best suited for cancer studies.

Compared with fluorescent proteins, bioluminescent proteins emit signal after substrate addition with a high signal-to-noise ratio but comparatively lower spatiotemporal resolution. 83 Therefore, bioluminescence-based reporters, such as gLuc-lactadherin and GlucB are recommended for labeling engineered exosomes insmallanimalmodelsatwhole-animal.

In some experiments, given the availability of imaging equipment, the researchers also used MRI to detect the biological action of engineered exosomes in vivo. 95,96 Taken together, the integration of bioluminescent proteins and SIM or CLSM is one appropriate strategy for live imaging of engineered exosomes in vivo.

units.statement: Combining radiotherapy with engineered exosomes increases accumulation of drug-loaded exosomes at tumor sites, alleviates radio-resistance, reboots immune response, and overcomes physical barriers such as the blood-brain barrier, with bursts of radiation mediating BBB penetration; NIS-loaded exosomes increase NIS protein on the plasma membrane of liver cancer cells facilitating radioiodine (131I) uptake and producing significantly greater antitumor effects of radionuclide therapy.
source_quotes: However, the study was not conducted in vivo, which impairs the reliability of the research results.
In addition to external beam radiotherapy (EBRT), the efficacy of 131 I internal radiotherapy could also be augmented by the sodium iodide symporter (NIS) protein-loaded exosomes.

The NIS-loaded exosomes increase the amount of NIS protein on the plasma membrane of liver cancer cells, which facilitate radioiodine uptake and consequently promotes 131 I internal radiotherapy. 130 The results proved significantly greater antitumor effect of 131 I radionuclide therapy following exosome NIS delivery.

Another example of radiotherapy combined with engineered exosomes is that the bursts of radiation could mediate the penetration of engineered exosomes through BBB and ultimately increase the accumulation of exosomes inside GBM.

units.statement: M1 macrophage-derived engineered exosomes (M1Exos) can be loaded with catalase to alleviate tumor hypoxia, deliver DNA-damage repair inhibitors, polarize macrophages from M2 to M1, and carry anti-PD-L1 nanobodies to terminate T-cell immunosuppression, thereby overcoming three radiotherapy-limiting factors simultaneously.

Besides, the oxygen from CAT-catalyzed endogenous hydrogen peroxide could efficiently overcome tumor hypoxia. 168 In vivo experiments demonstrated that these engineered exosomes promoted the efficacy of SDT, which showed a promising perspective for clinical translation.
